id-20260906-news-3.title: Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz Spike World Oil Prices, Indonesia Urged to Watch Energy Subsidy Burden and Inflation

segments.src: ## Jalur Vital yang Kembali Bergejolak
segments.tr: ## A Vital Route Once Again in Turmoil

segments.src: Selat Hormuz kembali menjadi sorotan pelaku pasar global setelah eskalasi ketegangan antara Amerika Serikat dan Iran di kawasan tersebut memicu kekhawatiran terhadap kelancaran distribusi minyak dunia.
segments.tr: The Strait of Hormuz has once again become the focus of global market players after an escalation of tensions between the United States and Iran in the region sparked concerns over the smooth distribution of world oil.

segments.src: Selat sempit yang menghubungkan Teluk Persia dengan Laut Arab ini dikenal sebagai salah satu jalur pelayaran energi tersibuk di dunia, karena sebagian besar ekspor minyak mentah dari negara-negara Timur Tengah melintasinya setiap hari.
segments.tr: This narrow strait connecting the Persian Gulf to the Arabian Sea is known as one of the busiest energy shipping lanes in the world, as most crude oil exports from Middle Eastern countries pass through it daily.

segments.src: Setiap kali muncul sinyal ketegangan geopolitik di sekitar jalur ini, pasar energi global cenderung bereaksi cepat.
segments.tr: Whenever signals of geopolitical tension emerge around this route, the global energy market tends to react quickly.

segments.src: Kekhawatiran atas potensi gangguan pasokan membuat pelaku pasar memasang harga premi risiko, yang pada akhirnya mendorong kenaikan harga minyak acuan dunia.
segments.tr: Concerns over potential supply disruptions have led market participants to price in risk premiums, which ultimately drives up global benchmark oil prices.

segments.src: ## Harga Brent dan WTI Menguat Tajam
segments.tr: ## Brent and WTI Prices Strengthen Sharply

segments.src: Berdasarkan pergerakan pasar energi global belakangan ini, harga minyak mentah acuan Brent dan West Texas Intermediate (WTI) tercatat mengalami kenaikan signifikan seiring meningkatnya kekhawatiran investor terhadap risiko gangguan pasokan dari kawasan Teluk.
segments.tr: Based on recent global energy market movements, the benchmark crude oil prices for Brent and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) have recorded significant increases alongside rising investor concerns over the risk of supply disruptions from the Gulf region.

segments.src: Analis energi menilai, selama ketidakpastian di sekitar Selat Hormuz belum mereda, fluktuasi harga minyak berpotensi terus berlanjut dalam beberapa waktu ke depan.
segments.tr: Energy analysts assess that as long as uncertainty around the Strait of Hormuz does not subside, oil price fluctuations have the potential to continue in the near future.

segments.src: Sejumlah lembaga riset energi juga mengingatkan bahwa volatilitas harga minyak akibat faktor geopolitik semacam ini bersifat dinamis dan dapat berubah cepat, tergantung perkembangan diplomatik maupun langkah-langkah yang diambil pihak-pihak terkait untuk meredakan ketegangan.
segments.tr: A number of energy research institutions have also reminded that oil price volatility due to such geopolitical factors is dynamic and can change rapidly, depending on diplomatic developments and the steps taken by related parties to ease tensions.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke Ekonomi Indonesia: Subsidi dan Inflasi Jadi Sorotan
segments.tr: ## Impact on the Indonesian Economy: Subsidies and Inflation Take the Spotlight

segments.src: Sebagai negara net importir minyak, Indonesia relatif rentan terhadap gejolak harga minyak dunia.
segments.tr: As a net oil importing country, Indonesia is relatively vulnerable to global oil price shocks.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga minyak mentah global berpotensi berdampak pada dua sisi sekaligus:
segments.tr: The rise in global crude oil prices has the potential to impact two sides simultaneously:

segments.src: - **Beban subsidi dan kompensasi energi** — Jika harga minyak dunia bertahan tinggi dalam waktu lama, beban anggaran negara untuk subsidi bahan bakar minyak (BBM) dan kompensasi energi berisiko membengkak, mengingat harga jual BBM bersubsidi di dalam negeri tidak serta-merta mengikuti fluktuasi harga pasar internasional.
segments.tr: - **Energy subsidy and compensation burden** — If world prices remain high for a long time, the state budget burden for subsidized fuel (BBM) and energy compensation risks swelling, considering that the selling price of subsidized fuel domestically does not automatically follow international market price fluctuations.

segments.src: - **Tekanan inflasi impor** — Kenaikan harga energi global turut mempengaruhi biaya logistik dan distribusi barang, yang pada gilirannya dapat menambah tekanan inflasi dari sisi biaya (cost-push inflation), terutama menjelang periode akhir tahun ketika permintaan domestik biasanya meningkat.
segments.tr: - **Imported inflation pressure** — The rise in global energy prices also affects the logistics and goods distribution costs, which in turn can increase cost-push inflation pressure, especially ahead of the year-end period when domestic demand typically increases.

segments.src: Para pengamat ekonomi menekankan pentingnya pemerintah dan otoritas terkait untuk terus memantau perkembangan harga minyak dunia secara berkala, sembari menyiapkan langkah antisipasi guna menjaga stabilitas anggaran maupun daya beli masyarakat.
segments.tr: Economic observers emphasize the importance of the government and related authorities to continue monitoring global oil price developments periodically, while preparing anticipatory steps to maintain budget stability and public purchasing power.

segments.src: ## Langkah Antisipasi yang Umum Dilakukan
segments.tr: ## Common Anticipatory Steps Taken

segments.src: Dalam situasi ketidakpastian harga energi global, sejumlah langkah yang lazim menjadi pertimbangan otoritas fiskal dan moneter di berbagai negara importir minyak, termasuk Indonesia, antara lain:
segments.tr: In situations of global energy price uncertainty, a number of steps commonly considered by fiscal and monetary authorities in various oil-importing countries, including Indonesia, include:

segments.src: 1. Mengevaluasi asumsi harga minyak dalam postur anggaran negara secara berkala.
segments.tr: 1. Periodically evaluating the oil price assumptions in the state budget posture.

segments.src: 2. Memperkuat koordinasi kebijakan fiskal dan moneter untuk meredam dampak inflasi impor.
segments.tr: 2. Strengthening fiscal and monetary policy coordination to dampen the impact of imported inflation.

segments.src: 3. Mendorong diversifikasi sumber energi guna mengurangi ketergantungan pada impor minyak mentah dan BBM dalam jangka menengah-panjang.
segments.tr: 3. Encouraging the diversification of energy sources to reduce dependence on crude oil and fuel imports in the medium-long term.

segments.src: 4. Menjaga komunikasi kebijakan yang transparan kepada publik agar ekspektasi pasar dan masyarakat tetap terkendali.
segments.tr: 4. Maintaining transparent policy communication to the public so that market and public expectations remain controlled.

segments.src: ## Menyikapi Ketidakpastian Global dengan Bijak
segments.tr: ## Addressing Global Uncertainty Wisely

segments.src: Ketegangan geopolitik di kawasan strategis seperti Selat Hormuz menjadi pengingat bahwa perekonomian domestik tidak lepas dari dinamika global.
segments.tr: Geopolitical tensions in strategic regions like the Strait of Hormuz serve as a reminder that the domestic economy is not detached from global dynamics.

segments.src: Meski demikian, sejarah menunjukkan bahwa lonjakan harga minyak akibat faktor geopolitik seringkali bersifat sementara dan dapat mereda seiring adanya perkembangan diplomatik atau redanya ketegangan di lapangan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, history shows that spikes in oil prices due to geopolitical factors are often temporary and can subside along with diplomatic developments or the easing of tensions on the ground.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat maupun pelaku usaha, perkembangan ini menjadi momentum untuk terus mencermati informasi resmi dari otoritas terkait, sekaligus bersikap bijak dalam merespons dinamika harga energi tanpa perlu bereaksi berlebihan terhadap isu yang masih terus berkembang.
segments.tr: For the public and business actors, this development becomes momentum to continue examining official information from related authorities, while acting wisely in responding to energy price dynamics without needing to overreact to issues that are still continuously developing.

segments.src: *Artikel ini bersifat informatif berdasarkan pergerakan pasar dan analisis umum yang berkembang, bukan merupakan rekomendasi kebijakan maupun ajakan bertindak tertentu.*
segments.tr: *This article is informative in nature based on market movements and general developing analysis, and is not a policy recommendation or a specific call to action.*

id-20260906-news-1.title: Danantara Reportedly Reluctant to Deposit Rp120 Trillion to the State, Here is Finance Minister Purbaya's Explanation at the 100 Economists Symposium

segments.src: Isu pengelolaan keuangan Badan Pengelola Investasi Danantara Indonesia kembali menjadi sorotan publik.
segments.tr: The issue of financial management at the Danantara Indonesia Investment Management Agency has once again become a public spotlight.

segments.src: Dalam sebuah forum Sarasehan 100 Ekonom, Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa mengungkapkan bahwa Danantara disebut-sebut masih keberatan untuk menyetorkan sebagian keuntungannya, yang diperkirakan mencapai sekitar Rp120 triliun, ke kas negara.
segments.tr: In a 100 Economists Symposium forum, Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa revealed that Danantara is reportedly still reluctant to deposit a portion of its profits, estimated to reach around Rp120 trillion, into the state treasury.

segments.src: Pernyataan ini pun memicu diskusi hangat di kalangan ekonom dan pengamat kebijakan fiskal mengenai posisi dan fungsi lembaga tersebut.
segments.tr: This statement has sparked a heated discussion among economists and fiscal policy observers regarding the position and function of the institution.

segments.src: ## Latar Belakang Danantara
segments.tr: ## Background of Danantara

segments.src: Danantara dibentuk sebagai badan pengelola investasi negara dengan mandat mengonsolidasikan aset-aset strategis milik negara agar dapat dikelola secara lebih profesional dan menghasilkan imbal hasil yang optimal.
segments.tr: Danantara was formed as a state investment management agency with a mandate to consolidate state-owned strategic assets so that they can be managed more professionally and generate optimal returns.

segments.src: Model semacam ini terinspirasi dari lembaga pengelola investasi negara lain di berbagai negara, yang biasanya berfokus pada akumulasi dan pengembangan aset jangka panjang, bukan semata sebagai sumber penerimaan tahunan bagi anggaran negara.
segments.tr: This model is inspired by state investment management institutions in various other countries, which usually focus on long-term asset accumulation and development, rather than merely serving as a source of annual revenue for the state budget.

segments.src: Namun demikian, karena berstatus badan milik negara, keuntungan yang dihasilkan Danantara tetap menjadi perhatian pemerintah, terutama dalam konteks kebutuhan pembiayaan Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN).
segments.tr: However, because it has the status of a state-owned body, the profits generated by Danantara remain a concern for the government, especially in the context of the financing needs of the State Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBN).

segments.src: ## Penjelasan Purbaya
segments.tr: ## Purbaya's Explanation

segments.src: Dalam kesempatan tersebut, Purbaya menjelaskan duduk perkara di balik keberatan yang disampaikan pihak Danantara.
segments.tr: On that occasion, Purbaya explained the situation behind the objections conveyed by Danantara.

segments.src: Menurutnya, ada pertimbangan strategis terkait kebutuhan modal kerja dan rencana investasi jangka panjang yang membuat manajemen Danantara berhati-hati sebelum menyetorkan sebagian besar keuntungannya ke kas negara.
segments.tr: According to him, there are strategic considerations regarding working capital needs and long-term investment plans that make Danantara's management cautious before depositing a large portion of its profits into the state treasury.

segments.src: Purbaya menyampaikan bahwa dirinya memahami logika bisnis yang mendasari sikap tersebut, namun juga menegaskan pentingnya menjaga keseimbangan antara kepentingan penguatan aset Danantara sebagai entitas investasi dan kebutuhan pemerintah dalam menopang penerimaan negara, khususnya di tengah tantangan fiskal yang dihadapi saat ini.
segments.tr: Purbaya stated that he understands the business logic underlying this stance, but also emphasized the importance of maintaining a balance between the interests of strengthening Danantara's assets as an investment entity and the government's need to support state revenue, especially amidst the fiscal challenges currently being faced.

segments.src: ## Perdebatan Peran Ganda Danantara
segments.tr: ## Debate on Danantara's Dual Role

segments.src: Pernyataan Purbaya ini turut memantik perdebatan di kalangan ekonom peserta sarasehan mengenai peran ganda Danantara: di satu sisi berfungsi sebagai "mesin laba" yang perlu memupuk modal untuk investasi berkelanjutan, di sisi lain juga diharapkan dapat menjadi salah satu penopang penerimaan APBN.
segments.tr: Purbaya's statement also sparked a debate among the economists participating in the symposium regarding Danantara's dual role: on one hand, it functions as a "profit engine" that needs to accumulate capital for sustainable investment, while on the other hand, it is also expected to be one of the pillars of APBN revenue.

segments.src: Sejumlah ekonom menilai penting adanya kejelasan regulasi dan tata kelola mengenai skema pembagian keuntungan (dividen) dari badan-badan investasi negara semacam ini, agar tidak menimbulkan ambiguitas antara fungsi akumulasi aset jangka panjang dan kontribusi fiskal jangka pendek.
segments.tr: A number of economists assessed the importance of clear regulations and governance regarding the profit-sharing scheme (dividends) from such state investment bodies, so as not to create ambiguity between the function of long-term asset accumulation and short-term fiscal contribution.

segments.src: Sementara itu, pihak lain berpendapat bahwa terlalu membebani Danantara dengan target setoran yang tinggi berpotensi menghambat kemampuannya untuk melakukan investasi strategis yang justru dibutuhkan demi pertumbuhan ekonomi jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, others argued that burdening Danantara too much with high deposit targets has the potential to hinder its ability to make strategic investments that are actually needed for long-term economic growth.

segments.src: ## Implikasi bagi Kebijakan Fiskal
segments.tr: ## Implications for Fiscal Policy

segments.src: Diskusi ini menggarisbawahi tantangan yang dihadapi pemerintah dalam merancang kebijakan fiskal yang tetap sehat tanpa mengorbankan tujuan pembangunan jangka panjang.
segments.tr: This discussion underscores the challenges faced by the government in designing a fiscal policy that remains healthy without sacrificing long-term development goals.

segments.src: Purbaya menekankan bahwa pemerintah akan terus berkomunikasi dengan manajemen Danantara untuk mencari titik temu yang saling menguntungkan, baik bagi keberlanjutan investasi negara maupun bagi kesehatan APBN.
segments.tr: Purbaya emphasized that the government will continue to communicate with Danantara's management to find a mutually beneficial middle ground, both for the sustainability of state investment and for the health of the APBN.

segments.src: Ke depan, publik dan para pelaku pasar tampaknya akan terus memantau perkembangan hubungan antara Kementerian Keuangan dan Danantara ini, mengingat besarnya potensi dampak terhadap arah kebijakan investasi negara serta stabilitas anggaran nasional.
segments.tr: Going forward, the public and market participants seem to continue monitoring the development of the relationship between the Ministry of Finance and Danantara, given the significant potential impact on the direction of state investment policy and national budget stability.

segments.src: Kejelasan mengenai skema setoran keuntungan ini diharapkan dapat segera dirumuskan agar tidak menimbulkan ketidakpastian bagi pelaku ekonomi maupun masyarakat luas.
segments.tr: Clarity regarding this profit deposit scheme is expected to be formulated soon so as not to cause uncertainty for economic actors and the wider community.

id-20260906-intro-marketing-3.title: [Marketing #3] Before Making a Product, Ask First: Market Research & How Consumers Decide to Buy

segments.src: > Riset pasar adalah cara terstruktur untuk mengurangi tebak-tebakan sebelum mengambil keputusan bisnis, dan perilaku konsumen menjelaskan bagaimana orang bergerak dari "kepikiran" sampai "checkout".
segments.tr: > Market research is a structured way to reduce guesswork before making business decisions, and consumer behavior explains how people move from "thinking about it" to "checkout".

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda mau buka kedai kopi di dekat kampus.
segments.tr: Imagine you want to open a coffee shop near campus.

segments.src: Anda bisa langsung sewa ruko dan berharap ramai — atau Anda bisa bertanya dulu: siapa yang lewat sini, jam berapa mereka haus, berapa yang mereka rela bayar.
segments.tr: You could just rent a shop space and hope it gets busy — or you could ask first: who passes by here, what time are they thirsty, how much are they willing to pay.

segments.src: Kegiatan bertanya secara sistematis itulah **riset pasar**.
segments.tr: That systematic act of asking is **market research**.

segments.src: Riset pasar yang baik selalu dimulai dari **masalah keputusan**, bukan dari kuesioner.
segments.tr: Good market research always starts from a **decision problem**, not from a questionnaire.

segments.src: Urutannya kira-kira begini:
segments.tr: The order is roughly like this:

segments.src: Masalah keputusan → Pertanyaan riset → Desain riset → Kumpulkan data → Analisis → Keputusan
segments.tr: Masalah keputusan → Pertanyaan riset → Desain riset → Kumpulkan data → Analisis → Keputusan

segments.src: Ada dua jenis data.
segments.tr: There are two types of data.

segments.src: **Data sekunder** adalah data yang sudah ada dan dikumpulkan orang lain — misalnya statistik penduduk BPS, laporan industri, atau data penjualan internal Anda sendiri.
segments.tr: **Secondary data** is data that already exists and was collected by others — for example, BPS population statistics, industry reports, or your own internal sales data.

segments.src: Data ini murah dan cepat, jadi selalu cek ini dulu.
segments.tr: This data is cheap and fast, so always check this first.

segments.src: **Data primer** adalah data yang Anda kumpulkan sendiri untuk masalah spesifik Anda: survei, wawancara, FGD (focus group discussion), observasi, atau eksperimen.
segments.tr: **Primary data** is data that you collect yourself for your specific problem: surveys, interviews, FGDs (focus group discussions), observations, or experiments.

segments.src: Desain risetnya sendiri biasanya dibagi tiga:
segments.tr: The research design itself is usually divided into three:

segments.src: - **Eksploratif** — untuk memahami masalah yang masih kabur. Sampelnya kecil, pertanyaannya terbuka. Contoh: wawancara 10 mahasiswa soal kebiasaan ngopi. Hasilnya berupa dugaan, bukan angka yang bisa digeneralisasi.
segments.tr: - **Exploratory** — to understand problems that are still vague. The sample is small, the questions are open-ended. Example: interviewing 10 students about coffee habits. The results are in the form of conjectures, not numbers that can be generalized.

segments.src: - **Deskriptif** — untuk mengukur "berapa banyak" dan "seperti apa". Ini wilayah survei dengan sampel besar. Contoh: berapa persen mahasiswa membeli kopi lebih dari 3 kali seminggu.
segments.tr: - **Descriptive** — to measure "how many" and "what it's like". This is the territory of surveys with large samples. Example: what percentage of students buy coffee more than 3 times a week.

segments.src: - **Kausal** — untuk menguji sebab-akibat lewat eksperimen. Contoh: uji A/B dua harga berbeda di dua cabang yang mirip, lalu bandingkan penjualannya.
segments.tr: - **Causal** — to test cause-and-effect through experiments. Example: A/B testing two different prices at two similar branches, then comparing the sales.

segments.src: Soal **survei**, tiga hal paling sering bikin hasil menyesatkan:
segments.tr: Regarding **surveys**, three things most often make results misleading:

segments.src: 1. **Pertanyaan menggiring (leading question).** "Seberapa suka Anda dengan kopi susu gula aren kami yang creamy?" sudah menyelipkan jawaban di dalam pertanyaan. Versi netral: "Bagaimana penilaian Anda terhadap rasa produk ini?"
segments.tr: 1. **Leading questions.** "How much do you like our creamy palm sugar milk coffee?" already slips the answer into the question. Neutral version: "What is your assessment of this product's taste?"

segments.src: 2. **Sampel yang tidak mewakili.** Menyebar kuesioner hanya di grup WhatsApp teman sendiri akan memberi gambaran yang terlalu optimis. Ini disebut *sampling bias*. Idealnya sampel dipilih acak (probability sampling); kalau tidak memungkinkan, minimal pastikan komposisinya menyerupai populasi target.
segments.tr: 2. **Unrepresentative samples.** Distributing questionnaires only in your own friends' WhatsApp groups will give an overly optimistic picture. This is called *sampling bias*. Ideally, the sample is chosen randomly (probability sampling); if that's not possible, at least ensure the composition resembles the target population.

segments.src: 3. **Niat ≠ perilaku.** Orang yang bilang "pasti beli" di kuesioner sering tidak jadi beli. Karena itu data perilaku nyata (transaksi, uji coba terbatas) biasanya lebih dipercaya daripada pernyataan niat.
segments.tr: 3. **Intention ≠ behavior.** People who say "definitely buying" in a questionnaire often don't end up buying. Therefore, real behavioral data (transactions, limited trials) is usually more trusted than statements of intent.

segments.src: Sisi lainnya adalah **perilaku konsumen**.
segments.tr: The other side is **consumer behavior**.

segments.src: Model klasik yang dipakai di hampir semua buku pemasaran adalah **proses keputusan pembelian lima tahap**:
segments.tr: The classic model used in almost all marketing books is the **five-stage purchase decision process**:

segments.src: 1. **Pengenalan kebutuhan** — sadar ada jarak antara kondisi sekarang dan kondisi yang diinginkan ("laptop saya lemot").
segments.tr: 1. **Need recognition** — aware of a gap between the current condition and the desired condition ("my laptop is slow").

segments.src: 2. **Pencarian informasi** — bertanya ke teman, baca ulasan, nonton video review.
segments.tr: 2. **Information search** — asking friends, reading reviews, watching review videos.

segments.src: 3. **Evaluasi alternatif** — membandingkan beberapa pilihan berdasarkan kriteria tertentu (harga, garansi, merek).
segments.tr: 3. **Evaluation of alternatives** — comparing several options based on certain criteria (price, warranty, brand).

segments.src: 4. **Keputusan pembelian** — memilih dan membayar. Di tahap ini masih bisa berubah karena pendapat orang lain atau faktor tak terduga (promo habis, stok kosong).
segments.tr: 4. **Purchase decision** — choosing and paying. At this stage, it can still change due to other people's opinions or unexpected factors (promo ended, out of stock).

segments.src: 5. **Perilaku pascapembelian** — puas atau kecewa. Kepuasan lahir dari perbandingan antara ekspektasi dan kinerja nyata produk. Kalau ekspektasi terlalu digelembungkan iklan, kekecewaan hampir pasti terjadi.
segments.tr: 5. **Post-purchase behavior** — satisfied or disappointed. Satisfaction is born from the comparison between expectations and the actual performance of the product. If expectations are too inflated by advertising, disappointment is almost certain to happen.

segments.src: Yang perlu dicatat: tidak semua pembelian melewati kelima tahap dengan sadar.
segments.tr: What needs to be noted: not all purchases go through all five stages consciously.

segments.src: Membeli air mineral di minimarket hampir tanpa proses berpikir (*low involvement*), sedangkan membeli motor bisa memakan waktu berminggu-minggu (*high involvement*).
segments.tr: Buying mineral water at a convenience store is almost without a thinking process (*low involvement*), whereas buying a motorcycle can take weeks (*high involvement*).

segments.src: Semakin besar risiko yang dirasakan — risiko uang, risiko salah pilih, risiko dinilai orang lain — semakin panjang proses pencarian informasinya.
segments.tr: The greater the perceived risk — financial risk, risk of choosing wrong, risk of being judged by others — the longer the information search process.

segments.src: Gunanya buat pemasar: setiap tahap butuh perlakuan berbeda.
segments.tr: The use for marketers: each stage needs different treatment.

segments.src: Tahap pencarian informasi dimenangkan lewat konten dan ulasan; tahap evaluasi dimenangkan lewat perbandingan yang jelas; tahap pascapembelian dimenangkan lewat layanan purnajual.
segments.tr: The information search stage is won through content and reviews; the evaluation stage is won through clear comparisons; the post-purchase stage is won through after-sales service.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Ambil contoh Bu Sari yang ingin membuka gerai *rice bowl* di kawasan perkantoran Sudirman, Jakarta.
segments.tr: Take the example of Ms. Sari who wants to open a *rice bowl* outlet in the Sudirman office area, Jakarta.

segments.src: **Data sekunder dulu.** Ia mengecek jumlah gedung perkantoran di sekitar, lalu melihat aplikasi pesan-antar untuk tahu berapa banyak gerai sejenis yang sudah ada dan berapa kisaran harga mereka: rata-rata Rp 28.000–Rp 40.000 per porsi.
segments.tr: **Secondary data first.** She checks the number of office buildings nearby, then looks at food delivery apps to know how many similar outlets already exist and what their price range is: on average Rp 28,000–Rp 40,000 per portion.

segments.src: Ini gratis dan bisa dilakukan dalam dua hari.
segments.tr: This is free and can be done in two days.

segments.src: **Riset eksploratif.** Ia mewawancarai 12 karyawan kantor saat jam makan siang.
segments.tr: **Exploratory research.** She interviewed 12 office employees during lunch hour.

segments.src: Muncul pola menarik: keluhan terbesar bukan harga, tapi waktu tunggu.
segments.tr: An interesting pattern emerged: the biggest complaint was not price, but wait time.

segments.src: Banyak yang cuma punya jeda 45 menit dan antrean sering makan setengahnya.
segments.tr: Many only have a 45-minute break and the queue often takes up half of it.

segments.src: **Riset deskriptif.** Dugaan itu lalu diuji lewat survei ke 200 karyawan dari beberapa gedung berbeda — bukan hanya satu gedung, supaya sampelnya lebih mewakili.
segments.tr: **Descriptive research.** That conjecture was then tested through a survey of 200 employees from several different buildings — not just one building, so the sample is more representative.

segments.src: Pertanyaannya netral, misalnya "Berapa lama waktu tunggu maksimal yang masih Anda terima saat makan siang?"
segments.tr: The questions were neutral, for example "What is the maximum wait time you can still accept during lunch?"

segments.src: bukan "Setuju kan kalau antre lama itu menyebalkan?".
segments.tr: not "Don't you agree that long queues are annoying?".

segments.src: Hasilnya: 68% menyebut maksimal 10 menit, dan 54% bersedia membayar Rp 5.000 lebih untuk jaminan pesanan siap saat tiba.
segments.tr: The result: 68% mentioned a maximum of 10 minutes, and 54% are willing to pay Rp 5,000 more for a guarantee that the order is ready upon arrival.

segments.src: **Riset kausal.** Sebelum investasi besar, Bu Sari uji coba dua minggu: minggu pertama tanpa sistem pra-pesan, minggu kedua dengan pra-pesan lewat WhatsApp.
segments.tr: **Causal research.** Before a big investment, Ms. Sari did a two-week trial: the first week without a pre-order system, the second week with pre-orders via WhatsApp.

segments.src: Karena hanya sistem pemesanan yang diubah — lokasi, menu, dan harga tetap sama — selisih penjualan bisa lebih masuk akal dikaitkan dengan perubahan itu.
segments.tr: Because only the ordering system was changed — location, menu, and price remained the same — the difference in sales can be more reasonably attributed to that change.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, tetap ada faktor lain yang tidak dikendalikan (misalnya cuaca atau tanggal gajian), jadi hasil dua minggu ini adalah indikasi awal, bukan bukti final.
segments.tr: It should be noted, there are still other factors that are not controlled (for example, weather or payday), so these two-week results are an initial indication, not final proof.

segments.src: Kalau dipetakan ke proses keputusan pembelian: karyawan tadi mengenali kebutuhan sekitar pukul 11.30 (lapar, waktu terbatas), mencari informasi di aplikasi atau grup kantor, mengevaluasi berdasarkan kecepatan dan harga, memutuskan, lalu menilai pascapembelian — dan kalau porsinya ternyata lebih kecil dari foto di aplikasi, kekecewaan itu langsung muncul jadi ulasan bintang dua.
segments.tr: If mapped to the purchase decision process: the employee recognized the need around 11:30 (hungry, limited time), searched for information on apps or office groups, evaluated based on speed and price, decided, then evaluated post-purchase — and if the portion turned out to be smaller than the photo in the app, that disappointment immediately appeared as a two-star review.

segments.src: Foto yang jujur, dalam kasus ini, adalah keputusan pemasaran.
segments.tr: Honest photos, in this case, are a marketing decision.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Riset pasar dimulai dari masalah keputusan, bukan dari kuesioner; cek data sekunder dulu sebelum mengumpulkan data primer yang mahal.
segments.tr: 1. Market research starts from a decision problem, not from a questionnaire; check secondary data first before collecting expensive primary data.

segments.src: 2. Desain riset dipilih sesuai tujuan — eksploratif untuk memahami, deskriptif untuk mengukur, kausal untuk menguji sebab-akibat — dan kualitas survei ditentukan oleh netralitas pertanyaan serta keterwakilan sampel.
segments.tr: 2. Research design is chosen according to the goal — exploratory to understand, descriptive to measure, causal to test cause-and-effect — and survey quality is determined by the neutrality of the questions and the representativeness of the sample.

segments.src: 3. Konsumen umumnya melewati lima tahap (pengenalan kebutuhan → pencarian informasi → evaluasi alternatif → keputusan → pascapembelian), dengan panjang proses bergantung pada tingkat keterlibatan dan risiko yang dirasakan.
segments.tr: 3. Consumers generally go through five stages (need recognition → information search → evaluation of alternatives → decision → post-purchase), with the length of the process depending on the level of involvement and perceived risk.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.tr: **2.** Monthly sales data from your own store's cashier system is considered **primary data**.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Data sekunder** — data yang sudah dikumpulkan pihak lain untuk tujuan lain, lalu dipakai ulang untuk riset kita (statistik pemerintah, laporan industri, data internal perusahaan).
segments.tr: - **Secondary data** — data that has been collected by other parties for other purposes, then reused for our research (government statistics, industry reports, internal company data).

segments.src: - **Data primer** — data yang dikumpulkan sendiri secara khusus untuk menjawab masalah riset yang sedang dihadapi.
segments.tr: - **Primary data** — data collected by yourself specifically to answer the research problem being faced.

segments.src: - **Sampling bias** — kesalahan sistematis yang muncul ketika sampel tidak mewakili populasi target, sehingga kesimpulannya menyesatkan.
segments.tr: - **Sampling bias** — systematic error that arises when the sample does not represent the target population, so the conclusion is misleading.

segments.src: - **Keterlibatan (involvement)** — tingkat kepentingan dan usaha berpikir yang dicurahkan konsumen pada sebuah pembelian; makin tinggi risikonya, makin panjang prosesnya.
segments.tr: - **Involvement** — the level of importance and thinking effort devoted by consumers to a purchase; the higher the risk, the longer the process.

segments.src: - **Disonansi pascapembelian** — rasa gelisah atau ragu setelah membeli, terutama pada produk mahal, yang bisa diredakan lewat garansi, layanan purnajual, dan komunikasi yang jujur.
segments.tr: - **Post-purchase dissonance** — feelings of anxiety or doubt after buying, especially for expensive products, which can be relieved through warranties, after-sales service, and honest communication.

id-20260906-news-2.title: BPS Notes July 2026 Trade Balance Surplus Narrows to US$120 Million, Iron, Steel and CPO Exports Rise But Not Yet Enough to Withstand Weakening Trend

segments.src: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) merilis data neraca perdagangan Indonesia periode Juli 2026 yang menunjukkan surplus tipis sebesar US$120 juta.
segments.tr: Statistics Indonesia (BPS) released Indonesia's trade balance data for the July 2026 period showing a thin surplus of US$120 million.

segments.src: Angka ini melanjutkan tren pengetatan surplus dagang yang sudah terlihat sejak pertengahan tahun, meski beberapa komoditas andalan ekspor seperti besi dan baja, minyak sawit mentah (CPO), serta batu bara mencatatkan kenaikan nilai maupun volume dibandingkan bulan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This figure continues the trade surplus tightening trend that has been visible since the middle of the year, even though several mainstay export commodities such as iron and steel, crude palm oil (CPO), and coal recorded increases in both value and volume compared to the previous month.

segments.src: ## Surplus Terus Menyempit Sejak Pertengahan Tahun
segments.tr: ## Surplus Continues to Narrow Since Mid-Year

segments.src: Menurut catatan BPS, surplus neraca dagang Juli 2026 berada jauh di bawah rata-rata surplus bulanan yang biasa dicatat Indonesia dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.
segments.tr: According to BPS records, the July 2026 trade surplus was well below the average monthly surplus usually recorded by Indonesia in recent years.

segments.src: Tren penyempitan ini disebut berlangsung sejak beberapa bulan sebelumnya, sehingga pelaku pasar dan pengamat ekonomi menilai perlu ada perhatian lebih terhadap struktur perdagangan luar negeri Indonesia, khususnya pada sisi impor yang tumbuh cukup signifikan.
segments.tr: This narrowing trend has reportedly been ongoing for the past few months, leading market participants and economic observers to assess that closer attention needs to be paid to Indonesia's foreign trade structure, particularly on the import side which has grown quite significantly.

segments.src: Meski nilai ekspor tiga komoditas utama—besi baja, CPO, dan batu bara—tercatat naik, kenaikan tersebut belum cukup untuk mengimbangi laju pertumbuhan impor, terutama impor bahan baku industri dan barang modal yang dibutuhkan untuk mendukung aktivitas manufaktur dalam negeri.
segments.tr: Although the export values of the three main commodities—iron and steel, CPO, and coal—were recorded as rising, this increase was not enough to offset the growth rate of imports, especially imports of industrial raw materials and capital goods needed to support domestic manufacturing activities.

segments.src: ## Kinerja Ekspor Komoditas Unggulan
segments.tr: ## Leading Commodity Export Performance

segments.src: Beberapa poin yang tercermin dari rilis BPS antara lain:
segments.tr: Several points reflected in the BPS release include:

segments.src: - **Besi dan baja**: permintaan dari pasar regional disebut menjadi pendorong utama kenaikan ekspor sektor ini, sejalan dengan aktivitas konstruksi dan industri di beberapa negara mitra dagang.
segments.tr: - **Iron and steel**: demand from the regional market was cited as the main driver of export growth in this sector, in line with construction and industrial activities in several trading partner countries.

segments.src: - **Minyak sawit mentah (CPO)**: kenaikan volume ekspor CPO turut ditopang oleh permintaan musiman dari negara-negara importir utama, meski pergerakan harga di pasar global tetap menjadi faktor yang perlu dicermati pelaku usaha.
segments.tr: - **Crude palm oil (CPO)**: the increase in CPO export volume was also supported by seasonal demand from major importing countries, although price movements in the global market remain a factor that business actors need to watch.

segments.src: - **Batu bara**: ekspor batu bara juga tercatat menguat, sejalan dengan kebutuhan energi di sejumlah negara tujuan ekspor.
segments.tr: - **Coal**: coal exports were also recorded as strengthening, in line with energy needs in a number of export destination countries.

segments.src: Kenaikan pada tiga sektor ini menunjukkan bahwa permintaan global terhadap komoditas unggulan Indonesia belum sepenuhnya melemah.
segments.tr: The increase in these three sectors indicates that global demand for Indonesia's flagship commodities has not completely weakened.

segments.src: Namun, secara keseluruhan, kontribusinya terhadap neraca dagang belum mampu mengimbangi tekanan dari sisi impor.
segments.tr: However, overall, its contribution to the trade balance has not been able to offset the pressure from the import side.

segments.src: ## Faktor yang Mendorong Penyempitan Surplus
segments.tr: ## Factors Driving the Surplus Narrowing

segments.src: Sejumlah pengamat ekonomi menilai penyempitan surplus dagang ini merupakan gabungan dari beberapa faktor, di antaranya dinamika harga komoditas global yang fluktuatif, penguatan permintaan domestik terhadap barang impor, serta perubahan pola perdagangan dengan beberapa mitra dagang utama.
segments.tr: A number of economic observers assess that this narrowing of the trade surplus is a combination of several factors, including fluctuating global commodity price dynamics, strengthening domestic demand for imported goods, and changing trade patterns with several major trading partners.

segments.src: Faktor-faktor ini disebut perlu terus dipantau agar tidak berdampak pada stabilitas nilai tukar maupun cadangan devisa dalam jangka menengah.
segments.tr: These factors are said to need continuous monitoring so as not to impact exchange rate stability or foreign exchange reserves in the medium term.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, sejumlah kalangan menilai pelemahan surplus tidak selalu berarti sinyal negatif secara keseluruhan, karena kenaikan impor barang modal dan bahan baku industri dapat mencerminkan geliat aktivitas produksi dalam negeri yang tetap berjalan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, some circles consider that the weakening of the surplus does not necessarily mean a negative signal overall, because the increase in imports of capital goods and industrial raw materials can reflect the ongoing momentum of domestic production activities.

segments.src: ## Respons dan Langkah ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Response and Way Forward

segments.src: Sejumlah asosiasi pelaku usaha berharap pemerintah dapat terus memperkuat daya saing produk ekspor unggulan, termasuk melalui hilirisasi industri dan diversifikasi pasar tujuan ekspor, agar ketergantungan pada fluktuasi harga komoditas global dapat dikurangi secara bertahap.
segments.tr: A number of business associations hope the government can continue to strengthen the competitiveness of superior export products, including through industrial downstreaming and export destination market diversification, so that dependence on global commodity price fluctuations can be gradually reduced.

segments.src: Selain itu, efisiensi rantai pasok dan penguatan substitusi impor pada sektor-sektor strategis juga disebut sebagai langkah yang perlu terus didorong.
segments.tr: In addition, supply chain efficiency and strengthening import substitution in strategic sectors are also mentioned as steps that need to be continuously encouraged.

segments.src: BPS sendiri menyatakan akan terus memantau perkembangan neraca dagang pada bulan-bulan berikutnya, mengingat dinamika ekonomi global—termasuk kebijakan dagang sejumlah negara mitra serta pergerakan harga komoditas—masih berpotensi memengaruhi kinerja ekspor dan impor Indonesia ke depan.
segments.tr: BPS itself stated it will continue to monitor the development of the trade balance in the following months, given that global economic dynamics—including the trade policies of a number of partner countries as well as commodity price movements—still have the potential to affect Indonesia's export and import performance going forward.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Data neraca dagang Juli 2026 ini menjadi pengingat bahwa meski ekspor komoditas unggulan Indonesia masih menunjukkan pertumbuhan, tren surplus yang terus menipis perlu dicermati sebagai bagian dari evaluasi kebijakan perdagangan luar negeri secara menyeluruh.
segments.tr: This July 2026 trade balance data serves as a reminder that although exports of Indonesia's leading commodities still show growth, the continuously thinning surplus trend needs to be scrutinized as part of a comprehensive evaluation of foreign trade policy.

segments.src: Publik dan pelaku usaha disarankan untuk terus memantau rilis data resmi dari BPS serta lembaga terkait lainnya guna mendapatkan gambaran yang lebih lengkap mengenai arah perekonomian nasional dalam beberapa bulan mendatang.
segments.tr: The public and business actors are advised to continue monitoring official data releases from BPS and other related institutions to get a more complete picture of the direction of the national economy in the coming months.
